---
title: "NFL Draft Predictor — Run All Files"
output: html_document
---

Knit this file from the project folder. It creates an `objects/` directory and renders the numbered phases in order, followed by the final report. File 01 downloads the combine dataset on the first run using `nflreadr`; later runs reuse the cached `data/combine_2000_2025.csv`.

```{r run-all}
files <- c(
  "01_data_preparation.Rmd",
  "02_baseline_logistic.Rmd",
  "03_logistic.Rmd",
  "04_knn.Rmd",
  "05_svm.Rmd",
  "06_ann.Rmd",
  "07_decision_tree.Rmd",
  "08_random_forest.Rmd",
  "09_probability_blend.Rmd",
  "10_evaluate_models.Rmd",
  "11_scouting_business_case.Rmd",
  "12_quality_checks.Rmd",
  "main.Rmd"
)

for (file in files) {
  cat("Rendering:", file, "\n")
  rmarkdown::render(file, quiet = TRUE,
                    envir = new.env(parent = globalenv()))
}
```
